consistencyRules.appliesTo: LucidDaily evaluation with the 50% consistency add-on

consistencyRulePct.quote: 40% (standard): your largest day must be 40% or less of your evaluation profit. Lowest price. 50% (add-on): your largest day can be up to 50%, so you can pass in as few as 2 days. Added at checkout for a small fee.
